title: Append extends an NBT list
description: Appending to marker data adds the new member while retaining both initial members.

steps.command: data modify entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,limit=1] data.values append value 8
